cmsPages.title: FAQ
cmsPages.content:
# Frequently Asked Questions

**Q: How do I book a ride?**
A: Sign up as a Guest, search for rides on your route, and subscribe to your preferred host.

**Q: How does pricing work?**
A: Guest subscriptions are distance-based. 0-5km = â‚¹30/route. Beyond 5km = â‚¹30 + â‚¹5 per extra km.

**Q: Can I change my host?**
A: Yes, once per subscription period with admin approval.

**Q: What is the buddy score?**
A: A trust metric based on ride history, reviews, and punctuality.

cmsPages.title: Privacy Policy
cmsPages.content:
# Privacy Policy

Last updated: June 2026

This privacy policy explains how Move Buddy collects, uses, and protects your personal information.

## What We Collect
- Name, email, phone number
- Location data for ride matching
- Payment information (processed securely)

## How We Use It
- Matching riders with hosts
- Processing payments
- Sending ride notifications

## Your Rights
You can request deletion of your data at any time by contacting support@movebuddy.com

cmsPages.title: Refund Policy
cmsPages.content:
# Refund Policy

## Subscription Refunds
Subscriptions are refundable within 24 hours of purchase if no rides have been booked.

## Ride Cancellations
If a host cancels, guests receive a full wallet credit.

## Process
Refunds are processed within 5-7 business days to your original payment method.

cmsPages.title: About Us
cmsPages.content:
# About Move Buddy

Move Buddy is India's smart daily commute platform connecting office workers and college students with trusted co-commuters.

## Our Mission
Make daily commuting affordable, safe, and social.

## Founded
2026 in Kolkata, India.

## Contact
Email: hello@movebuddy.com
Phone: +91 98765 00000

cmsPages.title: Terms of Service
cmsPages.content:
# Terms of Service

By using Move Buddy, you agree to these terms.

## Eligibility
You must be 18+ to use this platform.

## User Responsibilities
- Provide accurate information
- Treat co-commuters with respect
- Follow traffic laws

## Prohibited Activities
- Misuse of emergency SOS
- Fraudulent payment methods
- Creating fake accounts
